tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug gi cho ga rab gsal thar pa'i lam chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo// de la 'dir/ gang zag 'ga' zhig bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig la gnas pa/ snying rje dang shes rab ldan pa dag /gang gi tshe 'di'i bskyed rim zab mo bsgom par 'dod pa de'i tshe/ gtsang zhing nyams dga' ba'i gnas su byi dor bya ba sngon du song bas/ rten dgram pa/ rgyan dgod pa/ mchod gtor sogs nyer mkho sta gon bya zhing mdzes par bshams la/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i shar phyogs kyi char/ bde ba'i stan la grogs dang bcas pa 'khod pa'i mdun du/ thod pa chang gis bkang ba bdud rtsi dang ldan pa dang*/ rdo rje dril bu dang*/ cang te'u rnams bkod la/ nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas padma/ g.yon bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa gsal bar gyur/ oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kṛ ta badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi thugs ka nas/ yaṃ 'phros pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam ba dan dang yaṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ spros pa las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po 'bar ba raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de la kaṃ gsum spros pa las thod pa skam po bum ril gyi sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a spros pa las thod pa'i snod phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dbus su mu las dri chu baiḍūrya lta bu/ shar du bi las dri chen shel lta bu/ lhor ra las rakta gser btso ma lta bu/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar po/

byang du ma las klad pa ste bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ slar yang dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar lhor go las ba glang gi sha /lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha /nub byang du da las glang po che'i sha /byang shar du ha las rta'i sha ste sha lnga'o// rlung g.yos shing me sbar bas thod pa dros rdzas rnams zhu ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar po'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha dog sngon po'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sku'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha dog dkar po 'o ma'i rgya mtsho lta bur gyur/ bgegs gtor la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi gtor zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥsogs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang rang gi spyod yul du gyur pa'i snod rnams su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ādya nutpanna tātwa oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ skad cig gis rang nyid dpal rta mchog he ru kar gsal bar gyur/ lag gnyis rdo rje'i khu tshur rgyab sbyar ba'i mthe'u chung sbrel zhing*/ mdzub mo bgreng bas/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'= chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka'= bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa'i mthus/ gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams skad cig nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig /ṭākki hūm̐ dzaḥ so so'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ dhū pe= puṣpe= ā lo ke= gandhe= nai widya= shabda= rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo/ bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ udga te/

spha ra na i ma ga ga na khaṃ/ gṛhṇa i daṃ ba liṃ dyā swā hā/ lan gsum/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ gang dag dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la// mngon par dga' ba gang yin rnams// legs bshams mchod pa gtor ma dag /bzhes nas bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// gang dag dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthong ba dang thos par mi dbang ba'i bgegs de dag gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su song zhig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la rab tu 'bar ba'i ye shes kyi rdo rje chen pos mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o// rol mo mtshams rngam dang bcas pas rdo rje gsor zhing bsnun pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ hrīḥsogs dang*/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wā na bidya rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gtor ma dor/ mchod pa byin brlab ni/ mchod rdzas la bdud rtsi gtor zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥsogs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ bdug spos/ me tog /mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin dwangs shing thogs pa med pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed rgyas par 'gengs shing 'phro ba/

'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams su gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ dhū pe= puṣpe= nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ bar/ las kyi rdo rjes phyag byas nas/ rdo rje 'dzin sogs dgongs su gsol// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnyes bya dang*// yon bdag bsod nams bskyed bya'i phyir// gnyis med ting 'dzin sa la bzhugs// sa mā dhi kra ma hoḥ zhes brjod la phyag bya/ skyabs sems ni/ thal mo sbyar bas/ bdag gzhan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi rang bzhin/ so so'i yid mthun sprul pa'i gzugs ston pa'i sku/ chos kyi dbyings phyag rgya chen po'i thugs can/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri stong phrag bzhi'i gsung spro bar mdzad pa/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la= chos la= dge 'dun la= bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la= dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// gsum mam bdun nam nyer gcig brgya sogs/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin dbang po// rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// sems can rnams kyi don slad du// byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed ltar// de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// bsod nams ye shes byang chub lam// thabs dang shes rab goms pas bgrod// de bzhin bdag gis lam bgrod do// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// thams cad mkhyen par sangs rgyas nas// mkha' mnyam sems can don mdzad ltar// de bzhin bdag gis don bgyi'o// ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*// dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'da' ba dang*// kun kyang sangs rgyas thob par shog

/nam mkha' dang mnyam sems can kun// bde ldan sdug bsngal dang bral zhing*// spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang slad// rim gnyis zab mo bsgom par bya'o// lus sems dag pa dang*/ srung 'khor ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas padma/ g.yon bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar/ hrīḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin gyi 'od zer 'phro ba/ de'i 'od zer las khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i tshogs dang*/ me ri dang mtshon cha'i tshogs spros te/ bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad tshar bcad nas/ slar yang 'od zer las 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ bar rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur khang du gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ tshogs zhing ni/ slar rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rigs bzhi'i spyan ras gzigs yum dang bcas pa/ rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs shing gsal bar gyur/ rdor dril dang bcas pa'i spos bzung la/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha// dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gis ni// sems can don la dgongs pa'i bla med dkon mchog gsum// dngos dang yid kyis bshams shing mchod pa'i gnas 'di ru// bcom ldan rgyal ba 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gis mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ padma ka ma lā yā st+waṃ swā hā/

oṃ/ mchod yon bdug spos me tog snang gsal dri// zhal zas rol mo sha lnga rigs kyi yum// zag med bde chen bdud rtsi bde ba'i gnas// sha chen gsur dud zhun me dga' bde rgyas// snang ba sna tshogs lhan skyes ye shes bde// rang byung kun mkhyen ye shes mchod pa'i sprin// mchod par bzhes la dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ dhū pe= puṣpe= sogs kyis mchod la/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// 'khor 'das yon tan dpal dang ldan// bka' brgyud rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// padma dbang gis dkyil 'khor du// padma mchog gi skur sprul pa// gdug pa 'dul mdzad thod phreng la// gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// hrīḥ thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug sku// sku mdog dmar gsal 'jig rten dbang du sdud// spyan gyi 'od zer 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs// zhal nas hūm̐ sgras stong gsum chos sgra sgrog /shangs nas ye shes rlung gis nyon mongs 'thor// snyan gnyis thabs dang shes rab 'dul thabs mdzad// phyag gnyis dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med sbyor// g.yas pas bgrang phreng byang chub lam sna 'dren// g.yon pas padma 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral// zhabs gnyis 'gro ba'i don la snyoms par bzhugs// rin chen rgyan drug pha rol phyin drug ldan// 'gro rnams ma lus thugs rjes dbang du sdud// 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la phyag 'tshal lo// dgyes par rol pas 'dzab bstod mchod pa bzhes// dbang dang dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// gsung gi dbang phyug snang ba mtha' yas sku// 'chi med tshe dbang mgon po 'od dpag med// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad gsung las sprul// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// mi dmigs don gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/

༈ /phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*// yi dam lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas// tha ma da lta thug gi bar// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis// lus ngag yid gsum sgo nas ni// sdig pa dpag med bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba// khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags par bgyi// slan chad bdag ni mi bgyid do// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// 'phags pa nyan thos rang rgyal gyi// yan lag rnams kyang bzung bar bgyi// 'gro ba kun gyi dge ba la// bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*// bde gshegs chos sku la bzhugs par// 'gro ba kun la phan don du// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar ni// bdag ni rtag tu gsol ba 'debs// bde gshegs mdzad pa mthar phyin nas// mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed rnams la// bskal pa'i mtha' mar bzhugs par ni// bdag ni rtag tu gsol ba 'debs// bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang*// bgyis sam bgyid du stsal ba dang*// rjes su yi rang thams cad ni// 'gro ba kun gyis thob par shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag /bla mar bcas pa thams cad la// bdag gi lus 'di phul ba yis// theg pa dman la mi 'jug cing*// theg chen bla na med pa'i lam// zab cing rgya che bstan du gsol/ ༈ /ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// zhes pa nas// thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// tshad med bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ tshogs zhing gi lha tshogs rnams bdag nyid la thim par gyur/

oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi rnam par shes pa yi ge hrīḥdamar po ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od kha dog lnga 'phro ba'i 'od zer 'og gi phyogs su 'phros pas/ 'od zer las gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams padma rā ga las grub pa chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje yangs shing rgya che ba'i lte bar byang chub kyi shing snying po rgyan yid du 'ong ba 'bras bu dang lo ma thams cad nor bu rin po che bkra shis rdzas brgyad du grub pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las padma 'dab ma 'bum ldan rgyas pa chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'o// padma'i lte bar buṃ las gzhal yas kyi khang pa phyogs mdog gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ ka ba brgyad kyis yang dag par mdzes pa/ dbus su zlum skor gtso bo'i 'dom gang ba/ de'i nam mkha' la rgya gram gyi gdung gi mthar rin po che'i gdung zlum po rgya gram gyi khong gseng du zug pa/ de'i mthar rdo rje'i gdung zlum po/ de'i mthar 'khor lo'i gdung zlum po/ de'i mthar rgya gram gyi gdung gi sna bzhi phyir lhag pa la rdo rje'i rgya gram gyis mtshan pa ste thog gi dbyibs so// phyi yi dbyibs logs re re la gtso bo'i 'dom brgyad dang ldan pa/ ye shes lnga yi brdar rtsig pa rim pa lnga nang nas rim bzhin dmar po/ sngon po/ ser po/ dkar po/ ljang khu ste/ padma rā ga dang*/ baiḍūrya dang*/ gser dang*/ shel dang*/ ma rgad las grub pa zheng du khru lnga/ 'phangs su 'dom gsum pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu khru gang ba'i steng du/ rin po che'i baiḍūrya lta bu mun pa'i snam bu 'dom phyed pa/ de la ba so'i gseng khang khru gang ba'i bar bar du rin po che'i bre la rtsi pa tra'i kha nas byung ba'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/

de'i steng du gdung gi sna la rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa/ phyi la 'dom phyed lhag pa'i tshul gyis 'dod yon gyi snam bu dang mnyam pa'i steng du rdo kra ma shīrṣa las grub pa'i mda' yab kyis brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi glo 'bur gyi tshul du gnas pa la ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs cha bzhi bzhis mdzes pa/ gtso bo'i tog gi rdo rje rgya gram gyi steng du chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa bcu gsum dang ldan pa la gdugs char khebs dar dpyangs dang tog gis spras pa/ rta babs re re'i steng du chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa bcu pa char khebs tog bcas phyogs bzhi na ri dwags bzhi bzhi/ mtshams bzhi na ba dan bzhi bzhi/ rtsig pa'i rtsa bar 'dod yon gyi snam bus 'khor ba'i zur bcu gnyis la ba dan bcu gnyis kyis mtshan pa/ de'i phyi rol du chus bcad pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i ra ba gur khang me ri dang bcas pa'o// de'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥbabs pa las 'od 'phros/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod/ sems can la phog sdig sgrib dag nas 'od du zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ sems can thams cad thugs rje chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ 'od zer tshur 'dus rang la thim nas yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis yum gyi rgyab tu 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og mas rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi 'og mas padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings pa la dar gyi cod pan dang rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gnyis phyag gnyis ma/

phag zhal dmar mo spyi gtsug tu phyung ba/ rtsa ba'i khro zhal spyan gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba la thod pa skam po lngas brgyan pa/ thod pa rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan cing*/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug nam mkhar phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stobs pa'i tshul gyis 'khyud pa/ zhabs gnyis yab kyi rgyab nas 'khril ba'i tshul gyis skyil mo krung bcas nas bzhugs pa'o// de'i phyogs bzhir pad nyi'i steng du yi ge hrīḥbazhi las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du mi bskyod pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma sngon mo dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po/ yum mā ma kī ser mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ nub tu snang ba mtha' yas spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po/ yum gos dkar mo dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba/ byang du don yod grub pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ de dag thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi phyag dang po rnams lha mo la 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og ma rnams ni mu tig dmar po'i bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma rnams ni me tog padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha mo rnams kyi phyag dang po dag kyang rang rang gi bdag po'i rgyab tu thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og ma rnams ni rim pa bzhin 'khor lo dang*/ rin po che dang*/ padma dkar po dang*/ utpal 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma rnams ni padma dmar po 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis yab kyi rgyab tu 'khril ba'i tshul gyis skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/

sku la rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings pa la dar gyi cod pan dang*/ rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa'o// shar lho'i mtshams su ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon padma/ lho nub tu ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo g.yas nor bu/ g.yon padma/ nub byang du ni las padma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo g.yas bum pa/ g.yon padma/ byang shar du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu g.yas ral gri/ g.yon padma bsnams pa sku la rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o// phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la 'khod pa'i lha mo rnams ni gzugs rdo rje ma me long dang padma/ sgra rdo rje ma gling bu dang padma/ dri rdo rje ma spos phor dang padma/ ro rdo rje ma 'khar gzhong dang padma/ reg rdo rje ma na bza' dang padma bsnams pa'o// lha tshogs de dag thams cad kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par nyi ma la āḥdamar po/ thugs kar padma la hūm̐ sngon po dang hrīḥdamar po/ yab rnams kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥl/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ gis g.yas su bskor ba/ yum rnams kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥl/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī bud dha ḍā ki ni ye badzra warṇa nī ye badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas g.yon du bskor ba rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar ha ri ni sas mtshan pa'o// rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rten dang brten par bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par gyur/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ badzra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ/ mchod yon bdug spos me tog snang gsal dri// zhal zas rol mo sha lnga rigs kyi yum// zag med bde chen bdud rtsi bde ba'i gnas// sha chen gsur dud zhun me dga' bde rgyas// snang ba sna tshogs lhan skyes ye shes bde// rang byung kun mkhyen ye shes mchod pa'i sprin// mchod par bzhes la dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/

dhū pe= puṣpe nas/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig sems dpa' dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi 'khor lo gsal bar gyur/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rin po che'i bum pa thogs pa dpag tu med pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar gyur// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bum pa'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// chos dbyings ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ buddha a bhi ṣeñtsa oṃ/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur zhing chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la snang ba mtha' yas/ rdo rje phag mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ phyogs kyi yab yum rnams la mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu brgyan pa'o// bdag nyid kyi thugs kar padma la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs kar chos 'byung rkyang pa'i dbus kyi hrīḥdamar po las 'od zer kha dog dkar ser dmar ljang steng du 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mchod cing de dag kyang thugs rje chen por gyur pa char ltar bab cing rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer rnams 'phros/ zhal nas thon cing rigs bzhi'i spyan ras gzigs dang rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar thim/ de dag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer rnams byung*/ zhal nas thon cing bdag nyid yab yum gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim pas phrin las bzhi 'grub par gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ zhes gtso bo'i snying po yi ge bcu pa la/ oṃ badzra wā ra hī/ buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes yum gyi snying po'am yang na/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yongs kyi snying po btags la ci rigs bzla ba bdag bskyed do// ༈ //de nas bum pa lhag gnas ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa gnyis/ gu gul gyis bdug cing*/ oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kri ta badzra kro dha hya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pas bgegs bskrad/ me tog gi phreng ba dang bcas pa'i gos kyis mgrin par dkris/ oṃ badzra shi kha ri ru ṭa ma tra di shaṃ ban dha ban dha hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ rdo rje'i chu rgyun du bsams pa'i chu dang bum sman gyis dgang*/ a mri la sogs pa'i yal 'dab kyi kha brgyan/ ras dkar po'i steng du me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa la bshams/ lha'i rim pas/ oṃ hrīḥsogs dang*/ oṃ swa bhā was bsangs sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du paṃ yig dkar po las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po rtsa ba dang nag po med pa/ lto ba yangs pa/ mchu 'phyang ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgrin pa dkris pa/ rdo rje'i chu rgyun bum pa'i rdzas kyis gang bar gyur pa'i rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i nang du/ sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po las bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis yum gyi rgyab tu 'khyud pa'i tshul gyi thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og mas rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi 'og mas padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/

dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings pa la dar gyi cod pan dang rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gnyis phyag gnyis ma/ phag zhal dmar mo spyi gtsug tu phyung ba/ rtsa ba'i khro zhal spyan gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba la thod pa skam po lngas brgyan cing*/ thod pa rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug nam mkhar phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stobs pa'i tshul gyis 'khyud pa/ zhabs gnyis yab kyi rgyab nas 'khril ba'i tshul gyis skyil mo krung bcas nas bzhugs pa'o// de'i phyogs bzhir pad nyi'i steng du yi ge hrīḥbazhi las/ shar du mi bskyod pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma sngon mo dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po/ yum mā ma kī ser mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ nub tu snang ba mtha' yas spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po/ yum gos dkar mo dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba/ byang du don yod grub pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ de dag thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi phyag dang po rnams lha mo la 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og ma rnams ni mu tig dmar po'i bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma rnams ni me tog padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha mo rnams kyi phyag dang po dag kyang rang rang gi bdag po'i rgyab tu thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og ma rnams ni rim pa bzhin 'khor lo dang rin po che dang padma dkar po dang utpal 'dzin pa/

g.yon gyi 'og ma rnams ni padma dmar po 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis yab kyi rgyab tu 'khril ba'i tshul gyis skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings pa la dar gyi cod pan dang*/ rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa'o// shar lho'i mtshams su ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo g.yas rdo rje g.yon padma/ lho nub tu ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo g.yas nor bu/ g.yon padma/ nub byang du ni las padma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo g.yas bum pa/ g.yon padma/ byang shar du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu g.yas ral gri/ g.yon padma bsnams pa/ sku la rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o// las bum du padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la yi ge hrīḥtsheg drag dang bcas pa las khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog he ru ka sku mdog dmar po phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub rdo rje'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ sbrul dang dar gyi cod pan dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag pags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dor stabs su 'gying ba/ shin tu khro ba'i zhal can/ spyan gsum khro gnyer gyi rlabs dang ldan pa/ mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ sku la bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa'i gseb nas rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'tsher zhing gar byed pa tsam gyis dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o// gtso bo yab yum rigs bzhi'i spyan ras gzigs dpal rta mgrin rnams kyi thugs kar hrīḥrigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar ha ri ni sa de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug gi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par gyur/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ/ mchod yon bdug spos me tog snang gsal dri// zhal zas rol mo sha lnga rigs kyi yum// zag med bde chen bdud rtsi bde ba'i gnas// sha chen gsur dud zhun me dga' bde rgyas// snang ba sna tshogs lhan skyes ye shes bde// rang byung kun mkhyen ye shes mchod pa'i sprin// mchod par bzhes la dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/

dhū pe= puṣpe nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig sems dpa' dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi 'khor lo gsal bar gyur/ lha la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rin po che'i bum pa thogs pa dpag tu med pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar gyur/ spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bum pa'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// chos dbyings ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ bud dha a bhi ṣeñtsa oṃ/ ji ltar bltams pa= lha rnams kyis ni= lha yi chu ni= de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā sogs/ zhes dbang bskur zhing chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la snang ba mtha' yas/ rdo rje phag mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ phyogs kyi yab yum rnams la mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu brgyan pa'o// dpal rta mgrin la 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ slar yang*/ me tog bdug spos snang gsal dang*// dri chab zhal zas mchis pa kun// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra puṣpe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe= a lo ke= gandhe= nai widya pū dza me gha sogs/ gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro// reg dang 'dod yon rnam lnga po// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ sarba tā thā ga ta rū pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ shabda= gandhe= rasya= sparshe sogs/ sha chen spos dang dri yi byug /zhun chen snang gsal dri chen gyi// zhal zas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa a mṛ ta pañtsa aṃ ku sha pū dza me gha sogs/

sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa 'di// bde chen kun tu bde chen nyid// 'khor 'das kun khyab kun tu bzang*// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta na ta da ma hā su kha tā pu dza me gha sogs/ sa khams rang bzhin gti mug rnam par dag /gzugs phung gnas gyur chos dbyings ye shes bdag /bde gshegs kun dngos mgon po spyan ras gzigs// rnam par snang mdzad sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// nam mkha'i rang bzhin zhe sdang rnam par dag /rnam shes gnas gyur me long ye shes bdag /bde gshegs kun dngos mgon po spyan ras gzigs// mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// me khams rang bzhin nga rgyal rnam par dag /tshor ba gnas gyur mnyam nyid ye shes bdag /bde gshegs kun dngos mgon po spyan ras gzigs// rin chen 'byung ldan sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// chu khams rang bzhin 'dod chags rnam par dag /'du shes gnas gyur sor rtog ye shes bdag /bde gshegs kun dngos mgon po spyan ras gzigs// 'od dpag med mgon sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rlung khams rang bzhin phrag dog rnam par dag /'du byed gnas gyur bya grub ye shes bdag /bde gshegs kun dngos mgon po spyan ras gzigs// don yod grub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhes bstod/ hūm̐/ thugs kyi lha mchog rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal// sku mdog dmar nag dregs pa dbang du sdud// spyan gyi 'od zer 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs// zhal gyi 'dzum tshul thugs rjes kun la snyoms// mche bzhi gtsigs pas skye shi rtsad nas gcod// dbu gtsug rta mgo gzhan gyi 'gran du med// rta skad 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud// dbang bsdud phyag rgyas skye 'gro zil gyis gnon// padma'i phyag mtshan 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral// rin chen rgyan cha 'dod yon ma spangs dag /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskums ye shes sems dpa'i tshul// dbang chen rta mchog sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'jig rten dbang du sdud// 'jig rten zil gnon phrin las dngos grub stsol// zhes pas bstod/

rnam rgyal gyi steng du me tog phreng ba dang bcas pa'i rdo rje bzhag la/ gzungs thag lag pa g.yas kyis bzung zhing*/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥsngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer kha dog ser po byung ste// gzungs thag la brgyud nas bum pa'i nang gi lha'i thugs ka'i sa bon la phog pas/ thugs rgyud bskul bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ zhes dang yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī/ bud dha ḍā ki ni ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes yum gyi snying po dang*/ dhū ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya hūm̐ dzaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*/ las bum la/ oṃ hrīḥpadmānta sogs bzlas la/ rnam rgyal gyi lha rnams bde ba chen por zhu ba bum chu'i rnam par gyur/ khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin gyis bar chad kyi bgegs bsrung ba dang las thams cad sgrub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod do// ༈ //de nas mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng du/ bdud rtsi byang sems dkar dmar myos byed kyi bkang ba'i thod pa/ de'i steng du sindū ra'i maṇḍal bzhag la dar dmar pos dgab/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar du rdo rje/ lhor bgrang phreng ngam/ dbu rgyan/ nub tu yi ge drug pa'i glegs bam/ byang du mar me'am dril bu/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod pa dang*/ dkon mchog gi gtor ma/ dpal mgon po/ rang byung rgyal mo sogs bka' srung chos skyong gang byed kyi gtor ma rnams bshams la/ dkyil 'khor la bdud rtsi dang las buṃ gyi chu gtor zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kri sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ 'od zer las grub pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams padma rā ga las grub pa chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje yangs shing rgya che ba'i lte bar byang chub kyi shing snying po rgyan yid du 'ong ba 'bras bu dang lo ma thams cad nor bu rin po che bkra shis rdzas brgyad du grub pa/

de'i steng du paṃ las padma 'dab ma 'bum ldan rgyas pa chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'o// padma'i lte bar buṃ las gzhal yas kyi khang pa phyogs mdog gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ ka ba brgyad kyis yang dag par mdzes pa/ dbus su zlum bskor gtso bo'i 'dom gang ba/ de'i nam mkha' la rgya gram gyi gdung gi mthar rin po che'i gdung zlum po rgya gram gyi khong gseng du zug pa/ de'i mthar rdo rje'i gdung zlum po/ de'i mthar 'khor lo'i gdung zlum po/ de'i mthar rgya gram gyi gdung gi sna bzhi phyir lhag pa la rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa ste thog gi dbyibs so// phyi'i dbyibs log re re la gtso bo'i 'dom brgyad dang ldan pa/ ye shes lnga'i brdar rtsig pa rim pa lnga nang nas rim bzhin dmar po/ sngon po/ ser po/ dkar po/ ljang gu ste/ padma rā ga dang*/ baiḍūrya dang*/ gser dang*/ shel dang*/ ma rgad las grub pa zheng du khru lnga/ 'phangs su 'dom gsum pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu khru gang ba'i steng du/ rin po che baiḍūrya lta bu mun pa'i snam bu 'dom phyed pa/ de la ba so'i gseng khang khru gang ba'i bar bar du rin po che'i bre la rtsi pa tra'i kha nas byung ba'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du gdung gi sna la rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa/ phyi la 'dom phyed lhag pa'i tshul gyis 'dod yon gyi snam bu dang mnyam pa'i steng du rdo kra ma shīrṣa las grub pa'i mda' yab kyis brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi glo 'bur gyi tshul du gnas pa la ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs cha bzhi bzhis mdzes pa/ gtso bo'i tog gi rdo rje rgya gram gyi steng du chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa bcu gsum dang ldan pa la gdugs char khebs dar dpyangs dang tog gis spras pa/ rta babs re re'i steng du chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa bcu pa char khebs tog bcas phyogs bzhi na ri dwags bzhi bzhi/

mtshams bzhi na ba dan bzhi bzhi/ rtsig pa'i rtsa bar 'dod yon gyi snam bus 'khor ba'i zur bcu gnyis la ba dan bcu gnyis kyis mtshan pa/ de'i phyi rol du chus bcad pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i ra ba gur khang me ri dang bcas pa'o// de'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥbabs pa las 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod/ sems can la phog sdig sgrib dag nas 'od du zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ sems can thams cad thugs rje chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ 'od zer tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim nas yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis yum gyi rgyab tu 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og mas rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi 'og mas padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings pa la dar gyi cod pan dang rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gnyis phyag gnyis ma/ phag zhal dmar mo spyi gtsug tu phyung ba/ rtsa ba'i khro zhal spyan gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba la thod pa skam po lngas brgyan cing*/ thod pa rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug nam mkhar phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob pa'i tshul gyis 'khyud pa/ zhabs gnyis yab kyi rgyab nas 'khril ba'i tshul gyis skyil mo krung bcas nas bzhugs pa'o// de'i phyogs bzhir pad nyi'i steng du yi ge hrīḥbazhi las 'od 'phros/

sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du mi bskyod pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma sngon mo dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan spyan ras gzigs/ sku mdog dmar mo/ yum mā mā kī ser mo dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba/ nub tu snang ba mtha' yas spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po/ yum gos dkar mo dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba/ byang du don yod grub pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ de dag thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi phyag dang po rnams lha mo la 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og ma rnams ni mu tig dmar po'i bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma rnams ni me tog padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha mo rnams kyi phyag dang po dag kyang rang rang gi bdag po'i rgyab tu thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og ma rnams ni rim pa bzhin 'khor lo dang rin po che dang padma dkar po dang utpal 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma rnams ni padma dmar po 'dzin pa// zhabs gnyis yab kyi rgyab tu 'khril ba'i tshul gyis skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings pa la dar gyi cod pan dang rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa'o// shar lho'i mtshams su ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon padma/ lho nub tu ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo g.yas nor bu/ g.yon padma/ nub byang du ni las padma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo g.yas bum pa/ g.yon padma/ byang shar du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu g.yas ral gri/

g.yon padma bsnams pa/ sku la rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o// phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la 'khod pa'i lha mo rnams ni gzugs rdo rje ma me long dang padma/ sgra rdo rje ma gling bu dang padma/ dri rdo rje ma spos phor dang padma/ ro rdo rje ma mkhar gzhong dang padma/ reg rdo rje ma na bza' dang padma bsnams pa'o// lha tshogs de dag thams cad kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par nyi ma la āḥdamar po/ thugs kar padma la hūm̐ sngon po dang hrīḥdamar po/ yab rnams kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥl/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ gis g.yas su bskor ba/ yum rnams kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥl/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī bud dha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas g.yon du bskor ba rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar ha ri ni sas mtshan pa'o// rdul tshon skabs/ dngos gzhi'i nyin dang por dam ye bsre ba ni/ dzaḥhūm̐ ba hoḥ sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar gnas pa rnams dam tshig pa la thim par gyur/ sgrub mchod kyus la mi dgos so// rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rten dang brten par bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par gyur/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ badzra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥ dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ lho nub srin po'i grong khyer nas// grub thob bye ba 'bum gyi dbus// slob dpon padma gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas// mgon po tshe dbang 'od dpag med// spyan ras gzigs dbang gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mkha' spyod dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyi dbus// yum gcig mkha' 'gro=

dbang bskur= me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// rta mchog rgyal po he ru ka /dpa' bo'i tshogs bcas= dbang bskur= dag pa sku yi gzhal yas nas// chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro= dbang bskur= mi 'gyur thugs kyi gzhal yas nas// me long ye shes ngo bo nyid// rdo rje mkha' 'gro= dbang bskur= padma gsung gi gzhal yas nas/ sor rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid// padma mkha' 'gro= dbang bskur= yon tan rgyas pa'i gzhal yas nas// mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid// rin chen mkha' 'gro= dbang bskur= phrin las grub pa'i gzhal yas nas// bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid// las kyi mkha' 'gro= dbang bskur= 'jig rten dur khrod gzhal yas nas// bsam gyis mi khyab sprul pa'i tshogs// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// phrin las rnams bzhi bsgrub tu gsol// dam tshig chen po'i gnas mchog nas// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral tshogs// dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol// pho nya las mkhan mdzad du gsol// zhes rol mo bya/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho spyan ras gzigs// 'gro ba'i don du byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ swā hā/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ/ mchod yon bdug spos me tog snang gsal dri// zhal zas rol mo sha lnga rigs kyi yum// zag med bde chen bdud rtsi bde ba'i gnas// sha chen gsur dud zhun me dga' bde rgyas// snang ba sna tshogs lhan skyes ye shes bde// rang byung kun mkhyen ye shes mchod pa'i sprin// mchod par bzhes la dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ dhū pe= puṣpe nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig sems dpa' dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi 'khor lo gsal bar gyur/

lha la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rin po che'i bum pa thogs pa dpag tu med pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar gyur// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bum pa'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// chos dbyings ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis long*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ bud dha a bhi ṣeñtsa oṃ/ ji ltar ltams pa= lha rnams kyis ni= lha yi chu ni= de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur zhing chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la snang ba mtha' yas/ rdo rje phag mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ phyogs kyi yab yum rnams la mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu brgyan pa'o// zhes brjod/ padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// padma mchog gi sku sprul pa// gdug pa 'dul mdzad thod phreng la// gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// hrīḥ thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug sku// sku mdog dmar gsal 'jig rten dbang du sdud// spyan gyi 'od zer 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs// zhal nas hūm̐ sgras stong gsum chos sgra sgrog /shangs nas ye shes rlung gis nyon mongs 'thor// snyan gnyis thabs dang shes rab 'dul thabs mdzad// phyag gnyis dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med sbyor// g.yas pas bgrang phreng byang chub lam sna 'dren// g.yon pas padma 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral// zhabs gnyis 'gro ba'i don la snyoms par bzhugs// rin chen rgyan drug pha rol phyin drug ldan// 'gro rnams ma lus thugs rjes dbang du sdud// 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la phyag 'tshal lo// dgyes par rol pas 'dzab bstod mchod pa bzhes// dbang dang dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// gsung gi dbang phyug snang ba mtha' yas sku// 'chi med tshe dbang mgon po 'od dpag med// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad gsung las sprul// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// mi dmigs don gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes pas phyag 'tshal/

mchod bzhi bstod bzhi ni/ mchod rdzas la bdud rtsi gtor nas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kri sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs la/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ bdug spos/ me tog /mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin dwangs shing thogs pa med pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed rgyas par 'gengs shing 'phro ba/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams su gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ dhū pe= puṣpe nas/ shabda'i bar dang*/ de nas phyi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can nyon mongs bag chags sbyang slad du// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// khams gsum gnas pa'i dri ma dag gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchog dam pa 'di// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas// sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldan pas// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /oṃ āḥsogs sngags thog mtha' 'gre ba'i/ badzra dhū pe= dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa'i// lha rdzas dbyibs legs me tog dam pa 'di// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas// gzhal yas khang du sprin bzhin gtibs gyur cig /puṣpe sogs/ nyon mongs dug sreg ma rig mun sel ba'i// shes rab gzi ldan dpal gyi sgron me 'di// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du// 'od zer snang bas phyogs bcur gsal gyur cig /ā lo ke sogs/

stong gsum kun tu dri dang ngad ldan pa'i// spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang rgyal ba'i khrus// ye shes sprin phung mkha' la thugs rje'i char rgyun gyis// mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /gandhe sogs/ rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du lha rdzas bdud rtsi'i bshos// dag cing gtsang mar bshams te 'bul lags na// bsod nams zhing gyur rnams kyis bzhes su gsol// nai widya sogs/ dril chen sil snyan rnam grol tshangs pa'i dbyangs// bsam dag ngag gis bstod de gus mchod 'bul// sa bcu rim gyis bgrod nas sangs rgyas sar// tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas chos kyi rgyal por shog /shabda sogs/ rol mo bya/ hūm̐/ dus gsum bde gshegs yum gcig ma// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'gro la gzigs// gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// sku mdog dmar mo dbang gi tshul// tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad// rnam rtog rtsad gcod gri gug g.yas// 'khor ba dbang sdud thod khrag g.yon// skye 'chi rtsad gcod ral gri g.yas// dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭāṃ g.yon// thabs dang shes rab brkyang bskum bzhugs// 'dod yon rang dag rus pas brgyan// gzhon nu'i cha lugs cung zad khro// thugs rjes chags pas dbang du sdud// nam mthong dran pas ye shes skye// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// rdo rje rigs kyi dngos grub stsol// rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// nor dang bsod nams dngos grub stsol// padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// chags pa dbang sdud dngos grub stsol// las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// dgra bgegs tshar gcod dngos grub stsol// mkha' gsang ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// chos dbyings lhun grub dngos grub stsol// ma hā mu dra'i dngos grub stsol// rol mo bya/ nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ dug lnga rnam par dag pa yi// rigs lnga dang ni ye shes lnga// sha chen lnga yi mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// 'byung ba lnga po rnam dag pa// mā ma kī la sogs pa yi// rigs kyi yum chen 'byung ba lnga// shes rab dri med mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med cing*// zung 'jug bde ba chen po yi// kha dog yid 'ong reg byar ldan// zag med bde chen mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dbang bzhi bskur dang rgyud bzhi smin// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsol// rol mo bya/

hūm̐/ thugs kyi lha mchog rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal// sku mdog dmar nag dregs pa dbang du sdud// spyan gyi 'od zer 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs// zhal gyi 'dzum tshul thugs rjes kun la snyoms// mche bzhi gtsigs pas skye shi rtsad nas gcod// dbu gtsug rta mgo gzhan gyis 'gran du med// rta skad 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud// dbang sdud phyag rgyas skye 'gro zil gyis gnon// padma'i phyag mtshan 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral// rin chen rgyan cha 'dod yon ma spangs dag /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ye shes sems dpa'i tshul// dbang chen rta mchog sku la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'jig rten dbang du sdud// 'jig rten zil gnon phrin las dngos grub stsol// rol mo bya/ gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ thabs dang shes rab dbyer med cing*// yab yum bcu yi sbyor ba las// zag med bde ba chen po yi// ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// padma rang byung me tog la// rakta rang byung bde ba'i gnas// sha chen gsur dang bdug spos dang*// zhun chen snang gsal sgron me rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// lhan skyes bde ba chen po yi// dga' ba bzhi dang bde ba brgyad// zag med nyams kyis brgyan pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du// dpa' bo'i tshogs bcas rnal 'byor ma// gnyis med bde chen rol pa las// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// dbang bzhi bskur dang rgyud bzhi smin// gsang ba bla med dngos grub stsol// zhes rol mo bya/ 'gro ba kun la thugs rjes mnyam par gzigs// nyi ma'i 'od zer sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// chags rab don gyi 'gro ba dbang du sdud// rdo rje phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// sngags kyi las mdzad mdzes pa mkha' 'gro'i tshul// rgya mtsho gling gi mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// las kyi bka' sdod byin rlabs thogs med 'bebs// rdo rje phra men sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// bstan pa'i ru 'dzin gdug pa'i dgra 'dul ma// mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnal 'byor 'khor skyong byin brlabs char ltar 'bebs// mkha' 'gro zhi ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i// phyi nang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la// gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rol mo bya/

chos sku skye 'gag med pa la// rang byung ye shes mchod par 'bul// dus gsum skye 'gag med pa la// snang ba sna tshogs mchod par 'bul// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsol// thabs dang shes rab dbyer med cing*// lhan skyes ye shes bde ba che// zag med bde chen mchod par 'bul// dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i dngos grub stsol// dbyings dang ye shes ro mnyam zhing*// 'gag med ye shes lnga dang ldan// kun mkhyen ye shes mchod par 'bul// ngo bo nyid kyi dngos grub stsol// zhes de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul zhing rol mo bya'o// hūm̐/ mi 'gyur thugs kyis bdud bcom rdo rje'i rigs// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// re skong bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs rin chen rigs// rin chen mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// chags pa thams cad dbang sdud padma'i rigs// padma mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// don grub gdug pa 'dul mdzad las kyi rigs// las kyi mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// gdug pa 'dul mdzad rdo rje'i rigs su sprul// rdo rje ging chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'byung bar byed pa yi// rin chen ging chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// chags rab don gyis 'gro ba dbang du sdud// padma'i ging chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// las kyi mtha' yis bstan pa'i ru dra 'dul// las kyi ging chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dgongs pa lon pa padma 'byung gnas kyis// bdag dang mos pa'i gang zag la// byin rlabs chu bo'i rgyun bzhin phob// rol mo bya/ g.yon pa'i srin mdzub kyis bdud rtsi blangs nas nam mkhar mchod cing*/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ longs sku thugs rje chen po'i zhal du= sogs/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas zhal du= ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo'i=

te pu pa dri med bshes gnyen= ras chung rdo rje grags pa'i= bla ma zangs ri ras pa'i= 'gro mgon ras pa chen po'i= rgyal sras spom brag pa'i= grub chen karma pakshi'i= gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum gyi= chos rje rang byung rdo rje'i= mkhas btsun rin chen rgyal mtshan= maṃ ga la ke tu'i= rin chen bzang po'i= kun mkhyen mthong ba don ldan= byang sems dpal 'byor don grub= rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtsho'i= grub chen bkra shis dpal 'byor= mtshungs med mi bskyod rdo rje'i= rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag= rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje'i= gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug= rgyal mchog chos dbyings rdo rje'i= dpal ldan ye shes snying po'i= mtshungs med ye shes rdo rje'i= dpal chen chos kyi don grub= rgyal dbang byang chub rdo rje'i= si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas= rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje'i= mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho'i= padma nyin byed dbang po'i= theg pa mchog gi rdo rje'i= rgyal sras blo gros mtha' yas= kun bzang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i= padma dbang mchog rgyal po'i= dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer= rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje'i= drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lha lnga'i brgyud rim mam/ yang na/ 'jig rten dbang phyug zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ padma badzra zhal du= dza landha ra'i= mai tri pa'i= badzra pā ṇi'i= bha danta su ma ti kīrt+ti'i= ras chung rdo rje grags pa la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*// bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi rigs// spyan ras gzigs bzhi rigs kyi yum bzhi mchod// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro dpa' bo rgya mtsho dang*// dpa' mo rgya mtsho grub pa brnyes pa rnams// dam can rgya mtsho bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bul gyi// bzhes nas dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes bdud rtsi 'bul zhing*/

snying po ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ mā ṇi padme hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī/ bud dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ra ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yum gyi snying po dang*/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya hūm̐ dzaḥ ces dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yongs kyi snying po rnams mang nyung ci rigs bzla'o// ༈ //de nas slob dpon rang nyid dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ni/ las bum gyi chus khrus bya zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa= lha rnams kyis ni= lha yi chu ni= de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ bar chad bsal ba'i don du sngon 'gro gtor ma la bdud rtsis bsangs zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kri ta sogs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi spyod yul du gyur pa'i snod rnams su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ a kā ro sogs/ lan gsum/ skad cig gis rang nyid dpal rta mchog he ru kar gsal bar gyur/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa'i mthus/ gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams skad cig nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig /ṭakki hūm̐ dzaḥ so so'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ dhū pe= puṣpe nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ swā hā'i bar dang*/ rdor thal kha phye bas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa sogs lan gsum/ gang dag dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la// mngon par dga' ba gang yin rnams// legs bshams mchod pa gtor ma dag

/bzhes nas bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// gang dag dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthong ba dang thos par mi dbang ba'i bgegs de dag gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su song zhig /gang dag mi bgro ba de dag la rab tu 'bar ba'i ye shes kyi rdo rje chen pos mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o// rol mo mtshams rngams bcas/ oṃ hrīḥpadmānta sogs dang*/ oṃ sumbha ni sogs brjod la/ las bum gyi chus bsangs pa'i gdong g.yogs dmar po/ oṃ tsakṣu rbandha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐/ zhes pas bcings/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ gyis me tog gi phreng ba byin/ maṇḍal dang me tog sta gon byas la/ mtshungs med dpal ldan bla ma rin po che dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dpal thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho dbyer med pa'i drung du/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul ba'i thog mar yi ge brgya pa gsung 'tshal/ maṇḍal phyi zhing*/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya/ sogs yig brgya brjod/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ shin tu rnam par dag cing tshad med pa'i rdo rje'i sa bzhi'o// me tog dang bcas pa'i lag pas mtha' bskor zhing*/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje'i ri'i 'khor yug chen po'o// dbus su me tog spungs la/

oṃ haṃ ma hā me ra we na maḥ lhun po'i rgyal po ri bo mchog rab/ shar du/ oṃ yaṃ pūrba bi de hā ya na maḥ lus 'phags po'i gling*/ lhor/ oṃ raṃ dzaṃ bu dwī pā ya na maḥ 'dzam bu'i gling*/ nub tu/ oṃ laṃ a ba ra go dā ya na maḥ ba lang spyod kyi gling*/ byang du/ oṃ waṃ utta ra ku ra we na maḥ sgra mi snyan gyi gling*/ shar gyi g.yas/ oṃ yaṃ u pa dwī pā ya na māḥ lus kyi gling*/ shar gyi g.yon/ oṃ yaṃ u pa dwī pā ya na maḥ lus 'phags gling*/ lho'i g.yas/ oṃ raṃ u pa dwī pā ya na maḥ rnga yab kyi gling*/ lho'i g.yon/ oṃ raṃ u pa dī pa ya na maḥ rnga yab gzhan gyi gling*/ nub kyi g.yas/ oṃ laṃ u pa dwī pā ya na maḥ g.yo ldan gyi gling*/ nub kyi g.yon/ oṃ laṃ u pa dī pā ya na maḥ lam mchog 'gro'i gling*/ byang gi g.yas/ oṃ waṃ u pa dwī pā ya na maḥ sgra mi snyan gyi gling*/ byang gi g.yon/ oṃ waṃ u pa dwī pā ya na maḥ sgra mi snyan gyi zla'i gling*/ byang shar/ oṃ tsand+rā ya na maḥ thabs kyi zla ba/ lho nub/ oṃ sūryā ya na maḥ shes rab kyi nyi ma'o// gzhan yang rab 'byams mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtshos kun nas kun tu rgyas par gang ba'i rdo rje'i maṇḍal chen po'o// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*// yi dam lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus la// gling bzhi ri rab bcas pa dang*// gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya dang*// bye ba 'bum dang dung phyur bcas// maṇḍal gcig tu bsdus nas ni// mos blos gong ma rnams la 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// gu ru i daṃ maṇḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes 'bul/ bdag ni 'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba skyes// 'jig rten bya ba thams cad spangs nas ni// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog dam pa 'dir// mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par mdzad du gsol/

lan gsum/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi// lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhugs par 'tshal// zhes gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gi slob ma zhugs par bgyis// khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi sgo nang du gnas pas/ lha tshogs rnams kyi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal bar dmigs la phyag mdzod cig /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ zhes thal mo spyi bor sbyar nas/ na maḥte hūm̐/ mgrin par/ na mā mi hūm̐/ snying khar/ na mo na ma hūm̐/ sgo de nyid nas thon te dkyil 'khor gyi phyir g.yas bskor gyis song nas lho'i sgo nang du gnas pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyag mdzod cig /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ na maḥte hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ sgo de nyid nas thon te dkyil 'khor gyi phyir g.yas skor gyis song nas/ nub kyi sgo nang du gnas pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyag mdzod cig /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ na maḥte hūm̐/ na māḥmi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ sgo de nyid nas thon te dkyil 'khor gyi phyir g.yas skor gyis song nas/ byang gi sgo nang du gnas pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyag mdzod cig /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ na maḥte hūm̐/ na māḥmi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ slar shar gyi sgo nang du gnas pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i drung du sngags kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams blang nas bsrung snyam pa mdzod cig /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims rnams// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te bzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// zang zing chos dang mi 'jigs byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba// padma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor bzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog bsdus pa la// sdom pa thams cad yang dag ldan// kun nas so sor bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gi bskyed par bgyi// bdag gi sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// 'gro kun mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum/

de nas/ khyed rang rnams/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas mu tig dmar po'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon 'og mas me tog padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings pa la dar gyi cod pan dang rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa/ rnam bkra lha'i dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par sgoms shig /rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo dri'i chu dang bcas pas spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying gar reg cing*/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po// mgrin par āḥdamar po// thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du gyur// de nas sngags kyi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa'i phyir/ yi dam lha'i thugs kar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du/ don dam pa byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa re sgoms shig /snying gar rdo rje bzhag /oṃ sarba yo ga cittaṃ utpa da yā mi/ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥsiddhya badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ de nas dam tshig bsgrag pa la/ dang po dkyil 'khor lha'i dam tshig ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag /khyod ni rnal 'byor rigs su skyes// nga yis ye shes rdo rje sbyin// byin pas dngos grub thob par 'gyur// gang gis 'di 'dra ma mthong ba'i// drung du smra bar ma byed cig /bag med smras na nyams par 'gyur// de bas nga rgyal bcom nas ni// bdag nyid ma 'khrul shes par gyis// bdud rtsi lnga'i chu blud cing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis grub// oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha hūm̐/

de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' nyan pa'i dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag /deng 'di nas ni bu khyod kyis// rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyi// nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal pa// khyod kyis skyo ba med par sgrubs// gang yang nga la ma gus min// de bzhin gus par ma byas na// bdud kyis bcom nas ngan 'gror 'gro// de bas dam tshig gnas par gyis// de dag ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'o// sa gzhi spos chus sogs maṇḍal phul nas/ khyed rnams bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug tu bsgoms pa'i lus kyi nang stong zhing gsal ba'i lte bar padma 'dab bzhi'i steng du/ g.yung drung dmar po g.yon du 'khyil ba re/ de'i steng du hrīḥl sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la phog cing*/ 'od zer tshur 'dus nas lte ba'i hrīḥl thim pas/ lus sems thams cad bde ba chen pos khyab par sgoms shig /jo bo thugs rje chen po bskal pa bzang po'i tshogs dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ slob dpon padma grub thob brgyud pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dpal rta mgrin dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dam can chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa char bab pa ltar byon nas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pa'i mos pa rtse gcig tu mdzod/ gu gul gyis bdug /rol mo dang bcas pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī/ buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa ā be sha ya/

ā be sha ya/ aḥ.aḥ zhes ye shes pa ma phebs kyi bar du brjod la/ phebs nas ngo sprod pa'i phyir/ rdo rje'i glu blang ba ni/ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// sems nyid cir yang grub pa med// grub pa med pa'i sems nyid la// sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che// snang tsam nyid nas sems su 'dus// sems can kun gyi sems nyid de// bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin// rnam par mi rtog bsam mi khyab// gsal ba de yi ngo bor snang*// mos pa du ma'i sems can la// thabs rnams sna tshogs ston pa ste// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i sbyor ba yis// dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod// bsam gyis mi khyab go 'phang thob// spyan ras gzigs kyi byin brlabs yin// bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni// sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin du// skal ldan rnams kyi spyod yul yin// spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ tiṣṭha badzra/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha rnams kyi ni rigs ji bzhin// ji ltar bsod nams de bzhin shog /me tog gi phreng ba dkyil 'khor du dor zhing*/ bde gshegs snying po'i dkyil 'khor du// rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas// sngon tshe gang la sbyangs pa'i lha// gang yin de la phog par shog /pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ slar me tog blangs nas rigs gang yin pa'i spyan ras gzigs me tog dang dbyer med par spyi bor thim par bsams la/ sems dpa' stobs chen khyod kyis ni// 'di ni rab tu bzung bar bgyi// pra tī grihna i maṃ ba la ma hā sa twa/ khyod gtso bo 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rigs yin pas dpal dgyes pa'i padma zhes bya'o// mig dar bsal ba ni/ spyan ras gzigs dbang deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ dzñā na tsakṣu bi sho dha ya swā hā/

de nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bstan la/ ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che// dkyil 'khor snying po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor rigs su skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlobs// 'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub kun// thams cad 'di las 'byung bas na// dam tshig thams cad spyod pa dang*// dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig skyongs// gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis/ rdul tshon nam/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bris pa 'di dpe yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i gzhal med khang pa na/ rigs lnga'i spyan ras gzigs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'di lta bu bsgoms pa la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa yin pas/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la brtson par gyis shig /sa gzhi spos chus sogs maṇḍal phul la/ bum pa'i dbang gi don du/ padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// mgon po gzi brjid 'od dpag med// rgyal sras tshogs dang bcas pa la// dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa ltar// de bzhin bla ma khyod kyis kyang*// bdag la dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas mu tig dmar po'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon 'og mas me tog padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa// dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings pa la dar gyi cod pan dang rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa/ rnam bkra lha'i dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur pa la/ bum pa'i dbang bskur ba'i don du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/

mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rin po che'i bum pa thogs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod cig /bum pa spyi bor bzhag /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bum pa'i dbang*// rgyal sras rnams la bskur ba ltar// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// chos dbyings ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// sku mchog bum pa'i dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ bud dha a bhi ṣeñtsa oṃ/ bum chus bkrus shing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni= lha yi chu ni= de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de ltar rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bo bum pa'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa gti mug dag /gzugs kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes thob par sgoms shig /de nas rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba'i don du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams kyis rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ rdo rje 'di dang tha dad med par/ thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byon nas khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos par mdzod cig /rdo rje lag g.yas su byin la/ mi bskyod rgyal po rigs kyi gtso// zhe sdang rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// me long ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// thugs mchog rdo rje'i dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ badzra sa twa a bhi ṣeñtsa hūm̐/ de ltar mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dag /rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes thob par sgoms shig /de nas gsung mchog glegs bam gyi dbang bskur ba'i don du/

mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams kyis glegs bam gyi dbang bskur bas glegs bam 'di dang tha dad med par snang ba mtha' yas kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byon nas/ khyed rang la thim pas gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /yi ge drug pa'i glegs bam lag tu gtad la/ padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// 'dod chags rnam par dag pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung mchog dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sor rtog ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// gsung mchog glegs bam dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ padma a bhi ṣeñtsa hrīḥ de ltar 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo glegs bam gyi dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dag /'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes thob par sgoms shig /de nas dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur ba'i don du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams kyis dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur bas/ dbu rgyan 'di dang tha dad med par rin chen 'byung ldan gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byon nas/ khyed rang la thim pas rang byung ye shes kyi dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /dbu rgyan dang cod pan rin po che'i phreng ba mgo bor bcings la/ rin chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// nga rgyal rnam par dag pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// mnyam nyid ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// yon tan dbu rgyan dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ ratna a bhi ṣeñtsa trāṃḥ de ltar rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bo dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur bas/

nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dag /tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes thob par sgoms shig /de nas dril bu'i dbang bskur ba'i don du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams kyis dril bu'i dbang bskur bas/ dril bu 'di dang tha dad med par don yod grub pa'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byon nas khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ phrin las rnam bzhi'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /dril bu lag g.yon du byin/ phrin las yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du// phrag dog rang sar dag pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams kyi phrin las dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// bya grub ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// phrin las dril bu'i dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ karma a bhi ṣeñtsa aḥ de ltar don yod grub pa'i ngo bo dril bu'i dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog dag /'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes thob par sgoms shig /de nas ming gi dbang bskur ba'i don du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams kyis rdo rje'i ming gi dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod cig /rdo rje dril bu mgo thog tu bzhag la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi ming gi dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas nyid du rab bsgrub phyir// ming gi dbang mchog chen po sbyin// kye dpal dgyes pa'i padmo zhes bya'o// rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi rigs drug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo rdo rje'i brtul zhugs byin par mos shig /ces rdo rje lag tu gtad la/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta siddhī badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/

e ṣa dha ra yā mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ de ltar rdul tshon nam/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas lus la bum pa'i dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa lnga dag phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga yi spyan ras gzigs sgom pa la dbang ba yin no// sa gzhi spos chus sogs maṇḍal phul la/ gsang ba'i dbang gi don du/ padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// mgon po gzi brjid 'od dpag med// rgyal sras tshogs dang bcas pa la// dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa ltar// de bzhin bla ma khyod kyis kyang*// bdag la dbang bskur stsal du gsol// kā pa la'i bdud rtsi dang byang sems dkar dmar sbyar ba mgrin par btugs la/ slob dpon bdag nyid kyi phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i spyan ras gzigs dang*/ yum bzhi/ sems dpa' brgyad sogs su rnam par dag pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ yum gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma yab yum gnyis su med par sbyor ba las bdud rtsi byang sems kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thod pa'i dbang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis rab bsgrubs pa// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// gsang mchog thod pa'i dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya hūm̐ dzaḥ a bhi ṣeñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi slob ma'i lce la bzhag cing*/ de ltar rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas ngag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag nas/ rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa bsgoms pa la dbang ba yin no// sa gzhi spos chus sogs maṇḍal phul la/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du/ padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// mgon po gzi brjid 'od dpag med// rgyal sras tshogs dang bcas pa la// dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa ltar// de bzhin bla ma khyod kyis kyang*// bdag la dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// ces gsol ba btab/

khyed rang rnams skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas mu tig dmar po'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon 'og mas me tog padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings pa la dar gyi cod pan dang rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa/ rnam bkra lha'i dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur pa la/ sindū ra'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gis yum gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gnyis phyag gnyis ma/ phag zhal dmar mo/ spyi gtsug tu phyung ba/ rtsa ba'i khro zhal spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba la thod pa skam po lngas brgyan cing*/ thod pa rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug nam mkhar phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod khrag 'dzin par gyur pa'i rig ma sbyin pa ni/ gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags// 'khor lo rim pa'i sbyor ba yis// bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis// zhes slob ma la byin pa na/ des kyang gur gum la sogs pas dri zhim par byas shing*/ lus gos dang bral ba'i chu skyes slob ma la mngon sum du byas nas/ e ma bdag gi padma 'di// bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan// gang zhig cho gas brten byed pa// de'i mdun na bdag gnas so// sangs rgyas bstan pa la sogs pa// padmar bya ba ji bzhin gyis// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// bhañdza mokṣa hoḥ de nas yab yum lha'i gzugs kyis rdo rje dang*/ padma/ hūm̐ dang āḥlas skyes pa'i nor bu dang*/ ze'u 'bru dang oṃ dang āḥlas byung ba rdo rje'i khar phaṭa ser pos mtshan par gyur pa/

sangs rgyas kun gyi shes rab dbang*// sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsgrubs pa// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// shes rab ye shes dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog oṃ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya hūm̐ dzaḥ.a bhi ṣeñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes brjod la/ sindūr snying khar byug /gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang gnyis su med pa las/ dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la skye bar mos shig /de ltar chos kyi 'byung gnas sindū ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ sems la shes rab ye shes kyis dbang bskur bas/ sems kyi sgrib pa dag nas byang chub sems kyi gdams ngag sgom pa la dbang ba yin no// sa gzhi spos chus sogs maṇḍal phul/ dbang bzhi pa'i don du/ padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// mgon po gzi brjid 'od dpag med// rgyal sras tshogs dang bcas pa la// dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa ltar// de bzhin bla ma khyod kyis kyang*// bdag la dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ bla mas tshig gis brda sprad par bya ste/ me long yongs su dag pa la shar ba'i rdo rje 'chang gi gzugs brnyan ni gang las kyang ma skyes/ gnas pa'i tshe me long gi mdun rgyab bam/ rdul phra rab dang 'dres par yang mi gnas/ mi snang bar gyur pa'i tshe gang du'ang bzhud pa mi dmigs la mi dmigs bzhin du rdo rje 'chang gi gzugs brnyan gsal bar snang ba ltar/ rang gi lus yi dam gyi lha'i sku stong bzhin du nye bar snang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dpe'i khyad par du ma can shin tu 'od gsal ba las/ de nyid kyi tshe'ang snang ba nyid rang bzhin med pa'o// de bzhin du brag cha 'byung ba'i phyogs su gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ sngags kyi sgra dang bstod pa dang skur 'debs sogs brjod pa na/ brag ca las kyang de nyid gsal bar brjod pa 'byung ba na/ rang bzhin mi dmigs pa ltar rang gis brjod pa'i sgra grags pa nyid kyi tshe na'ang rang bzhin med par stong bzhin du ā li kā li sogs stong pa nyid kyi rang sgra 'byung ba ste med snang ro mnyam pa'o// de bzhin du smig rgyu chu med pa la ri dwags rnams kyis chur 'du shes nas bsnyegs mod kyi/

de la nam yang chu mi rnyed de nyam nyes par 'gyur la/ smig rgyur shes pa na de la brten pa'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ nyam nyes pa mi 'byung ba ltar/ sems rnam par g.yo ba'i rgyun/ smig rgyu ltar nye bar snang ba la/ byis pa rnams kyi ngor/ bde sdug 'khor 'das sogs nye bar dmigs te/ spang blang sogs mtshan ma la spyod pas ngal ba thob par 'gyur la/ rang gi sems smig rgyu ltar snang ba 'di ni nges par rang bzhin med pa ste/ 'khrul grol gyi mtshan ma rnams rnam pa thams cad du ma dmigs pa yin min/ yod med sogs mtha' dang bral ba mnyam pa nyid chen po'i dbyings/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ye shes gzhom du med pa nyid du blta bar bya'o// de ltar snang srid phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas sgo gsum la bzhi pa'i dbang bskur bas sgo gsum cha mnyam gyi sgrib pa dag nas lam phyag pa chen po sgom pa la dbang ba yin no// dbang 'di rnams kyi don yang padma zab pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa/ bum pa'i dbang ni dang po ste// gsang ba'i dbang ni gnyis pa'o// shes rab ye shes gsum pa ste// nges shes bskyed pa bzhi pa yin// lha dang sngags dang stong pa nyid// bde stong 'dres par sgom pa dbang*// tha mal lus kyi rnam rtog ni// dang po bum pa'i dbang gis bcad// rang bzhin lha yi rnam par bsgom// tha mal ngag gi rnam rtog ni// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang gis bcad// bzlas brjod rgyun du bzlas pa'o// tha mal sems kyi rnam rtog ni// gsum pa shes rab dbang gis bcad// bde dang stong pa'i don dran bya// 'bras bu thams cad bsdus pa ni// bzhi pa ye shes dbang yin no// zhes gsungs pa yin no// sa gzhi spos chus sogs maṇḍal phul la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du/ gang gi bdag ni khyod drin las// rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*// thugs rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol// rdo rje stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs su gyur/
