thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das mchog gi dang po'i skyes bu'o// zhes slob ma'i lag pa g.yas su gtad/ de ni rdo rje'i dam tshig go /dril bu stong pa'i ngang las/ āḥlas skyes pa'i dril bu/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyings kyi rjes 'gror bshad// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung*// g.yon du gtad/ slob mas kyang*/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi bdag /ngo bo nyid kyang 'gal srid byas/ rang bzhin dag mchog sems dpa' yis// dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur// zhes brjod cing dkrol/ de ni dril bu'i dam tshig go /khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba dang*/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya kha sbyor gyi rim pas byin gyis brlabs pa/ 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis/ yid kyi lus brtan brtul zhugs ni// phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod// gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan// des na phyag rgya rab tu bsgrags// zhes brjod/ de ni phyag rgya'i dam tshig go /slob ma bdag nyid kyi zhal du zhugs shing*/ sku yi dbyibs brgyud de/ lha mo'i padmar gnas pa/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ dang rdo rje las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'/ ye shes sems dpa' dang dbyer med pa la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang*/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams la rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod par bya ba/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā dyaṃ= dhū pe= sogs/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de ltar 'di la stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pa las de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab dang snyoms par zhugs pas/

de rnams 'dod chags chen pos zhu bar gyur pa rnam snang gi sgo nas nang du zhugs te/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ba'i khu bas dbang bskur nas/ slar padma nas phyung ste gral du gnas pa la/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma dang bcas pas/ bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bskang ba phyag gi cung zad yo bar 'dzin pas/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang bcas pas dbang bskur bzhin pa dang*/ rnam rgyal gyi bum pa'i chu mi bskyod pa'i bdag nyid byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis dbang bskur bar gyur pa ni/ bum pa kha rgyan rdo rje dang bcas pas slob ma'i spyi bor reg la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum pa yi phyag byas pa// rdo rje gsang ba gsum byung ba// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dbang bskur bas/ bde ba chen po phun tshogs par gyur pa'i spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan rnams dang lha mo rnams ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bor bcug par gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣtha badzra ye swā hā/ me tog la sogs pa mdun du bsham nas/ oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe a lo ke gandhe nai wīdya pra tītstsha swā hā/ 'di lta bu go bar bya ste/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon gyis ni dbang du 'dod// de las gzhal yas kyi khang pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin no// zhes bya ba sogs dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid rnam par dag pa dang*/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu bsgrags// skye mched khams dang dbang po ni// byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /ces sogs lha rnams kyi de kho na nyid rnam par dag pa dang*/

don dam par ni dkyil 'khor la sogs pa rnams kyang rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid de bzhin nyid kho na'i de kho na nyid rnam par dag pa dang*/ de nyid bcu la sogs pa'i slob dpon gyi las kyi rim pa ji snyed pa dang*/ 'da' bar bya ba ma yin pa'i ngo bo'i dam tshig dang*/ bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa'i bdag nyid can gyi sdom pa rnams shes pas de kho na nyid bzhin du myur du bsgrub par bya zhing*/ gzhan dag kyang gzhug par gyis shig /rdo rje dril bu gtad la/ rdo rje dang ni dril bu long*// rdo rje la ni rab tu gnas// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// rigs lnga'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ lag tu 'khor lo gtad la/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ khyod kyis sems can gti mug can rnams kyi don gyis shig /rdo rje lag tu byin la/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa// rdo rje'i 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// khyod kyi sems can zhe sdang can rnams kyi don gyis shig /rin po che lag tu byin la/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa// nor bu'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor// khyod kyis sems can nga rgyal can rnams kyi don gyis shig /padma lag tu byin la/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad kyi// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa// pad ma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor// khyod kyis sems can 'dod chags can rnams kyi don gyis shig /sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu byin la/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa// rgya gram 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// khyod kyis sems can phrag dog can rnams kyi don gyis shig

/sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ spyi bor sindhu ra'i thig le byas la// khyod rnams kyis dus thams cad du bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa spyi bor bsgom pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku'i phrin las sgrub par gyis shig /sngags gtad pa'i don du/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes mchog /dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol// zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags kyis bskor ba las/ sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas zhal nas brgyud de rang gi zhal du zhugs nas snying ga'i hrī la thim par mos la sngags zlos shig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ dhū ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya hūm̐ dzaḥ lan gsum brjod nas/ slob dpon gyis me tog gtor zhing*/ bcom ldan bdag gi sbyin lags kyi// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol// slob mas kyang*/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum/ deng phyin chad sngags kyi bzlas pa la brtson pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung gi phrin las sgrub par gyis shig /snying gar sindū ra byug la/ deng nas bzung ste sems can rnams la snying rje chen po bskyed de/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs kyi phrin las sgrub par gyis shig /slob dpon sprul sku'i cha lugs lag pa g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar 'dzin pa snying khar bzung ba dang*/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas/ de ring ngas khyod lung bstan te// 'od dpag med pa de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun las grol// kye dpal dgyes pa'i padmo zhes bya'o// sarba ta thā ga ta sid dhi sa ma ya stāṃ bhur bhu wa swaḥ ma 'ongs pa na rigs kyi gsang mtshan dang mthun pa'i de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur te/ gang 'di ltar lung bstan pa de/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston pa yin te/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can gdul dka' ba rnams kyi don du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi gzugs su gyur pas bde ba chen po la 'god par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na khyod rnams kyis deng phyin chad bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgo nas 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po sgrubs shig /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// sa gzhi spos chus sogs maṇḍal phul/ deng nas brtsam te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyi slob ma bzung ba yi// cha shas kyang ni spyad du gsol// de dag ni slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o// rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bden stobs brjod pa ni/ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag sgrubs shig /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrubs shig /nyes pa med pa rtag pa ste// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags// 'dod chags chen po dga' ba che// bcom ldan de nyid bdag sgrubs shig /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems su bdag sgrubs shig /dngos grub chen po mchog gi mchog /dbang phyug chen po rgyal ba'i rgyal// grub pa'i rdo rje cher gsal bas// rdo rje snyems par bdag sgrubs shig /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa// sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// sems can kun gyi yab nyid de// 'dod chags mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi// bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa// mgon po khyod kyi bden pa des// bdag gi 'dod pa skong gyur cig

/ces brjod/ ༈ de nas las kyi rdo rjes phyag btsal nas/ tshogs kyi yo byad la byin rlabs mdzad par zhu/ zhes gsol ba btab/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams la nang mchod gtor zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥpadmānta sogs dang*/ oṃ swa bhā was bsangs sbyangs la/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi thugs ka nas/ yaṃ 'phros pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam ba dan dang yaṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ spros pa las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po 'bar ba raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de la kaṃ gsum spros pa las thod pa skam po bum ril gyi sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a spros pa las thod pa'i snod phyir dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dbus su mu las dri chu baiḍūrya lta bu/ shar du bi las dri chen shel lta bu/ lhor ra las rakta gser btso ma lta bu/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar po/ byang du ma las klad pa ste bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ slar yang dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar lhor go las ba lang gi sha /lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha /nub byang du da las glang po che'i sha /byang shar du ha las rta yi sha ste sha lnga'o// rlung g.yos shing me sbar bas thod pa dros rdzas rnams zhu ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar po'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha dog sngon po'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sku'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha dog dkar po 'o ma'i rgya mtsho lta bur gyur/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po 'di/ rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa/ skye ba med pa/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa ā li kā li/ mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di 'bul ba'i gnas ni/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud kyi bla ma'i zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs kyi zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/

phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma'i zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes lan gsum/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// slob dpon padma dbang gi lha// rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas// mgon po tshe dbang 'od dpag med// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbus nas bzhengs// 'dir gshegs= mkha' spyod dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// gsang ba ye shes ḍā ki ma// mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbus nas bzhengs// 'dir gshegs= me dpung 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// khro bo'i rgyal po'i rta mchog dpal// dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i dbus nas bzhengs/ 'dir gshegs= sa bla sa 'og sa steng gi /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyang*// 'dir gshegs= dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro rdzu 'phrul can// 'dir gshegs= pho nya las mkhan mdzad du gsol// dam tshig chen po'i gnas mchog nas// dam can rgya mtsho sku bskyod 'tshal// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub tu gsol// rol mo bya/ tshogs kyi phud gtor ma la bran nas/ oṃ hrīḥpadmānta sogs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs ka nas sogs/ 'o ma'i rgya mtsho lta bur gyur/ bar sngar ltar byin gyis rlabs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams sprin gyi phung po lta bur bzhugs par gyur/ rdor thal kha phye bas/ na mo ratna gu ru i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ te pu pa dri med bshes gnyen/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ bla ma zangs ri ras pa/ 'gro mgon ras pa chen po/ rgyal sras spom brag pa/ grub chen karma pakshi/

gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje/ mkhas btsun rin chen rgyal mtshan/ maṃ ga la ke tu/ rin chen bzang po/ kun mkhyen mthong ba don ldan/ byang sems dpal 'byor don grub/ rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtsho/ grub chen bkra shis dpal 'byor/ mtshungs med mi bskyod rdo rje/ rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag /rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje/ gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug /rgyal mchog chos dbyings rdo rje/ dpal ldan ye shes snying po/ mtshungs med ye shes rdo rje/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub/ rgyal dbang byang chub rdo rje/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas/ rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje/ mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho/ padma nyin byed dbang po/ theg pa mchog gi rdo rje/ rgyal sras blo gros mtha' yas/ kun bzang mkha' khyab rdo rje/ padma dbang mchog rgyal po/ dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer/ rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du 'bul lo// byin gyi rlobs par mdzad du gsol/ yang na/ 'jig rten dbang phyug /padma badzra/ dza landā ra/ mai tri pa/ badzra pā ṇi/ bha danta su ma ti kirt+ti/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du 'bul lo// byin gyi rlobs par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī= i daṃ= oṃ dhu ma gha= i daṃ= bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ rdo rje phag mo/ rdo rje rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ rin chen rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ padma rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ las kyi rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ sangs rgyas spyan ma/ mā ma kī/ gos dkar mo/ dam tshig sgrol ma/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ padma mkha' 'gro/ las kyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du 'bul lo// mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/

oṃ ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ i daṃ= trag rakṣa ma hi dun bhyo ma hā yakṣa tīkṣ+ṇa kā li dun bhyo/ i daṃ= dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ma hā kā la bdud 'dul rdo rje'i ded dpon 'jig byed chen po ber nag can/ dregs pa pho dgu/ mo dgu/ phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po bcu/ dregs pa'i gtso bo bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ ye shes kyi mgon po'i tshogs/ las kyi mgon po'i tshogs/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po'i tshogs rnams dang*/ dpal lha mo rang byung gi rgyal mo srung ma dpal ldan ma/ ma mo bdun/ sring mo bzhi/ 'bar ma dgu/ dus bzhi'i lha mo/ dmag gi rgyal mo bzhi/ dbang phyug ma nyer brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang bka' brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bdag gi phrin las rnam pa bzhi 'grub pa dang*/ bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams bsal du gsol/ zhes bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la 'bul lo// las kyi rdo rjes lag pa g.yas su thabs kyi rdzas sha lnga sogs/ g.yon du shes rab kyi rdzas chang sna lnga sogs bzung la/ dang por slob dpon la/ hūm̐/ dpa' bo chen po dgongs su gsol// gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom bya mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum// rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol// zhes gus pa dang bcas pas drangs la/ slob dpon gyis kyang pad skor dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// 'dod chags dri ma dang bral ba'i// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// de kho na nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ a hoḥsu kha/ zhes blangs/ gzhan rnams la'ang de bzhin du tshogs drangs shing*/ lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa/ lus phung khams skye mched lha tshogs su gsal ba la bdud rtsa'i mchod pa phul bar bsams la longs spyod/

phud dang lhag ma phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa slob dpon gyi kha bshal ba'i chang gis bran la/ las kyi rdo rjes phyag btsal/ lhag ma'i gtor ma la byin rlabs mdzad par zhu/ zhes gsol ba btab/ phud dang lhag ma'i gtor ma bzang zhing rgya che bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ utstshiṣṭa badzra a ha ha ha tre pa tre paṃ/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ hūm̐/ gzhan yang las kyi mkha' 'gro ma// shin tu 'jigs pa'i keng rus gzugs// yan lag rus pa'i 'khor los brgyan// snying khrag rngub cing rkan sgra sgrog /rkang mgyogs brtul zhugs gdug rtsub can// dam tshig can gyi las mkhan yin// dam tshig nyams pa'i srog gcod yin// phud lhag bshal chu'i gtor ma bzhes// dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa srungs// da res nyul la mel tshe mdzod/ hūm̐/ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro rdzu 'phrul can// srin po'i gzugs la ce spyang gdong*// sbrul nag lce la spyan mig glog /kha rlangs dug la nga ro 'brug /mi lpags g.yab mo phyogs bcur rdeb// rgyu zhags 'dom dgus dgra bo 'ching*// khros pa'i smin phrag ser chen 'bebs// bye ba dung phyur sa ma ya// ba spu mtshon cha me ltar 'bar// dam tshig can gyi= sogs/ hūm̐/ sha za'i mkha' 'gro yang sprul tshogs// yi dwags lus la dur bya'i gdong*// chu srin rkan la thod pas brgyan// lus la rnag khrag chu ser lhags// smre sngags tshig la ngu 'bod dbyangs// phyi nas 'dre tshub sprin bzhin ldang*// bkra mi shis shing rjes ngan gtong*// ro langs rkang pas dur khrod nyul// phung srid lag pas srog rtsa gcod// gza' srin mig gis zla tshes blta// dam tshig can gyi= sogs/ hūm̐/ gzhan yang mkha' 'gro pho nya'i tshogs// las la myur zhing bstan pa srung*// ce spyang mang po rol du khrid// bu chung lus la bya rog gdong*// bshugs glu'i dbyangs la smre sngags tshig /ri gsum 'grim zhing lung gsum skor// chu la zhon nas grib so 'grim// dkyil 'khor mtha' ma bskor zhing nyul// dam tshig can gyi las mkhan yin// dam tshig nyams pa'i srog gcod yin// phud lhag bshal chu'i gtor ma bzhes// dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa srungs// da res nyul la mel tshe mdzod// oṃ sarba utstshiṣṭa/

bhū tāe bhyaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes brjod/ rol mo dang bcas pas phyi rol srang mdor dor/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ slar mchod pa kha gsos la/ oṃ hrīḥpadmānta sogs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ bdug spos/ me tog /mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin dwangs shing thogs pa med pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed rgyas par 'gengs shing 'phro ba/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams su gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ dhū pe= puṣpe= nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ bar gyis byin brlabs la/ oṃ/ mchod yon bdug spos me tog snang gsal dri// zhal zas rol mo sha lnga'i rigs kyi yum// zag med bde chen bdud rtsi bde ba'i gnas// sha chen gsur dud zhun me dga' bde rgyas// snang ba sna tshogs lhan skyes ye shes bde// rang byung kun mkhyen ye shes mchod pa'i sprin// mchod par bzhes la dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ dhū pe= puṣpe= nas/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ sgrub mchod dkyus la de tsam gyi 'thus so// rdul tshon skabs grol nyin gong gis byin brlabs 'phros su cung zad rgyas par/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// zhes pa nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ gang ltar/ hrīḥ thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug sku// sku mdog dmar gsal 'jig rten dbang du sdud// spyan gyi 'od zer 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs// zhal nas hūm̐ sgras stong gsum chos sgra sgrog /shangs nas ye shes rlung gis nyon mongs 'thor// snyan gnyis thabs dang shes rab 'dul thabs mdzad// phyag gnyis dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med sbyor// g.yas pas bgrang phreng byang chub lam sna 'dren// g.yon pas padma'i 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral// zhabs gnyis 'gro ba'i don la snyoms par bzhugs// rin chen rgyan drug pha rol phyin drug ldan// 'gro rnams ma lus thugs rjes dbang du sdud// 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// dgyes par rol pas 'dzab bstod mchod pa bzhes// dbang dang dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// gsung gi dbang phyug snang ba mtha' yas sku// 'chi med tshe dbang mgon po 'od dpag med// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad gsung las sprul// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// mi dmigs don gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes dang*/

sa khams rang bzhin gti mug rnam par dag /gzugs phung gnas gyur chos dbyings ye shes bdag /bde gshegs kun dngos mgon po spyan ras gzigs// rnam par snang mdzad sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// nam mkha'i rang bzhin zhe sdang rnam par dag /rnam shes gnas gyur me long ye shes bdag /bde gshegs= mi bskyod rdo rje'i= me khams rang bzhin nga rgyal rnam par dag /tshor ba gnas gyur mnyam nyid ye shes bdag /bde gshegs= rin chen 'byung ldan= chu khams rang bzhin 'dod chags rnam par dag /'du shes gnas gyur sor rtog ye shes bdag /bde gshegs= 'od dpag med mgon= rlung khams rang bzhin phrag dog rnam par dag /'du byed gnas gyur bya grub ye shes bdag /bde gshegs= /don yod grub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pas bdag cag rnams la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ dril bu bsil zhing dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor zhing*/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya/ sogs yig brgya lan gsum brjod la/ shar phyogs su dkyil 'khor la phyogs pas 'dug ste/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// gang yang bdag blo rmongs gyur pas// legs byas 'di la nyes gyur gang*// gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol// zhes bzod par gsol la/ dkon mchog rin chen gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dge ba 'di yis nye bar mtshon nas ni// sems can rnams kyis dus gsum bsags pa yi// zag bcas zag med zung 'jug dge ba rnams// bla med byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi// 'gro kun thams cad mkhyen pa thob par shog /kun gzhi byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du// bdag cag sems can thams cad kyi dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/

dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa tsam bye ba phrag khrig bsam gyis mi khyab pa bdag la da lta nyid du 'byung zhing*/ 'gro drug gi sems can thams cad skad cig la myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'god par gyur cig /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten mgon// tshad med thugs rje'i phrin las kyi// rtsod dus bstan pa'i snyigs ma 'dir// spyan ras gzigs dbang dkyil 'khor du// kun kyang sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces sogs bsngo ba smon lam bya'o// oṃ/ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs su gsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// sems can rnams kyi don slad du// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ badzra muṃḥ zhes pas ye shes pa gshegs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ rdzogs rim ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor 'das thams cad lhar gsal ba la phog /de thams cad 'od du zhu ste bsrung ba'i gur khang la thim/ de zhu ba las rim bzhin bdag nyid la 'dus te/ bdag nyid thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/ hrīḥyang gong bu dang nā da'i gzugs las rnam par 'das nas rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no// zhes mnyam par bzhag /slar yang rang nyid zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i spyan ras gzigs su gsal bar gyur/ de'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam thams cad bya zhing chos thams cad skye ba med par mos te/ dril bu dkrol zhing*/ a kā ro= sogs brjod la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i rdo rje rtse mos shar sgo nas bzung ste/ tshang thig gi steng nas gtso bo'i gnas kyi bar dbyi zhing*/ rdul tshon cung zad rang gi mgo la bzhag nas/ sgo dang zur rnams kyang rdo rje'i rtse mos bshig nas rdul tshon bsdus la/

thig la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams mi mngon par byas la/ bka' brgyud bla mas legs byin pa'i// rtag tu ye shes thugs rje yis// gzigs shing chos skur ngo sprod pa'i// byin rlabs mchog gi bkra shis shog /yi dam lha yis legs byin pa'i// gsang sngags mchog gi cho ga la// lus ngag yid gsum mthus grub pa'i// dngos grub mchog gi bkra shis shog /rdo rje mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// sems nyid 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// gnyis med dpe bral don rtogs pa'i// phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// chos rnams rang bzhin rang gi sems// rgyud 'di chos kyis ma bcings pa'i// chos kyi phyag rgya'i bkra shis shog /rin chen mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// yon tan dpag tu med pas brgyan// nad dang gdon las thar ba yis// bsam pa grub pa'i bkra shis shog /padma mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med sbyor// bde chen ye shes thabs kyi mchog /gsang ba shes rab bkra shis shog /las kyi mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa la// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las rnams 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /zhes dang*/ chos dbyings lhun gyis grub pa la// dbyer med 'khor 'das yongs su rdzogs// dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum// chos sku mchog gi bkra shis shog /rnam snang ye shes gangs chen mtsho// mi 'khrugs rgyal po la sogs pa'i// rgyal ba sras bcas 'khor gyis bskor// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog /thub chen rgyal ba gser mdog can// skal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi dbus// rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa// sprul sku mchog gi bkra shig shog /sku gsum lhun grub yongs rdzogs shing*// ye shes dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du// ngo bo nyid kyi thams cad mkhyen// sku bzhi yongs rdzogs bkra shis shog

/sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje ni// yid bzhin nor bu rnyed pa ltar// bdag gzhan yongs kyi dbul ba sel// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /byang chub sems kyi phrin las kyi// thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs med 'phro// bco lnga'i zla ba nya rgyas ltar// 'dzam gling 'jig rten bkra shis shog /ces brjod do// grol nyin/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhag pa// 'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang*// gang yang sa steng gnas pa dang*// sa blar rgyu ba gang yin pa// mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su// thams cad tha dad 'gro bar gyis/ sarba bhu ta gatstsha/ zhes bsngo smon mtha' rgyas su bya'o// dge des sgrub brgyud snying po'i rings lugs mchog /mi nub bskal pa'i bar du rab 'phel zhing*// ma rnams theg pa mchog gi snod gyur te// bla med bde ba chen pos gnas thob shog /ces karma pas rnam thos kyi ri bor bris pa bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// /karma legs bshad gling gi bshad grwa ru// bla ma bsod nams rab rgyas zhes bya bas// gzhan phan lhag bsam bzang po'i mthus bskyed kyis// spar du bsgrubs dges 'gro kun 'tshang rgya shog /dge'o// //
